svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Move subscriptions to organizations
svg.desc: Subscriptions and invoices used to hang off a person. They now hang off an organization, which arrives with a membership table, and the Stripe customer moves with them.
